card-reconciliation.author: Jane Doe
card-reconciliation.identity: Unglamorous control that catches real money
card-reconciliation.disclosure: I haven't run a card program in-house, but I reviewed hundreds of card reconciliations as an outside accountant.
card-reconciliation.identity_line: Card reconciliation looks like admin work. Skip it for two months and it turns into a cleanup project.
card-reconciliation.what_people_get_wrong: People treat the card statement as the record. The statement shows what was charged. The receipts and the ledger show what the business actually bought.
card-reconciliation.biggest_mistake: Posting the statement total to one expense account. Personal charges, duplicates and refunds disappear into it, and nobody finds them until the tax return.
card-reconciliation.hard_rule: Every charge gets a receipt and a ledger match before the month closes.
good_fit_if: You have more than one cardholder
Card spend is a real share of your monthly expenses
avoid_if: You expect the bank feed to categorize everything for you
You plan to reconcile once a year at tax time
card-reconciliation.memorable_line: The statement tells you what was charged. Only the reconciliation tells you what was bought.
data_log: Unmatched charges at month end, receipt deadline enforced
Unmatched charges at month end, no deadline
Business days to close the card after the statement date
card-reconciliation.first_hand: At client firms, the cards with no receipt deadline were the ones still holding personal charges at year end.
card-reconciliation.difficulty_rating: 2 of 5. Easy task, easy to let slide.
card-reconciliation.expert_take: Set the receipt deadline first and pick the software second. Most card problems come from doing it the other way round.
card-reconciliation.freshness: Updated October 2026: receipt rules checked against the 2026 demo expense policy template.

month-end-close.author: Jane Doe
month-end-close.identity_line: A month-end close is a relay race: every handoff has a deadline, and one late leg stalls the whole team.
month-end-close.what_people_get_wrong: People think a fast close means working late on day one. A fast close comes from work done before month end: accruals estimated, cutoffs agreed, reconciliations rolling.
month-end-close.biggest_mistake: Letting one person prepare and review the same reconciliation. Errors survive the close and show up in the audit.
month-end-close.hard_rule: Nothing is closed until it ties to a source document. A balance without support is a guess.
good_fit_if: You have three to eight people in finance
You close monthly and report to owners or a lender
avoid_if: You are a one-person bookkeeping shop
You only close the books at year end
month-end-close.memorable_line: A boring close is a good close.
month-end-close.first_hand: On my team, the close slipped every time bank reconciliations started on day two instead of day one.
month-end-close.expert_take: If a task has no owner on the calendar, it gets done on day six.
month-end-close.freshness: Updated October 2026: checklist re-checked against the 2026 demo close survey.

cash-vs-accrual.author: Jane Doe
cash-vs-accrual.identity: Timing decision most owners make by accident
cash-vs-accrual.identity_line: Cash vs accrual is a timing decision: cash shows when money moved, accrual shows when the business earned it or owed it.
cash-vs-accrual.what_people_get_wrong: People think cash basis is simpler, so it must be safer. It hides unpaid bills and unbilled work, so the profit number is wrong in exactly the months that matter.
cash-vs-accrual.biggest_mistake: Running the books on cash and then applying for a loan. The statements get rebuilt on accrual under a deadline.
cash-vs-accrual.hard_rule: Pick one method for the books and use it every month. Switching back and forth makes the trend meaningless.
good_fit_if: You carry inventory or give customers payment terms
Someone outside the business reads your statements
avoid_if: You run a small cash-only side business
Nobody will keep the accruals up to date every month
cash-vs-accrual.memorable_line: Cash tells you what happened to the bank. Accrual tells you what happened to the business.
data_log: Months to convert one demo client from cash to accrual
Profit swing between methods in one demo quarter
Accrual entries per month after setup
cash-vs-accrual.first_hand: For one client, the cash books showed a profitable December only because the January supplier bills had not been paid yet.
cash-vs-accrual.difficulty_rating: 2 of 5. Simple rules once the method is chosen.
cash-vs-accrual.expert_take: Decide who reads the statements before you decide the method.
